what: Drift pin regex is applied to the whole ci.yaml file.
scenario_or_breakage: Pattern ^ [a-z][a-z0-9_-]+:$ also matches workflow keys under on: (e.g. workflow_dispatch pull_request push) producing false job names and brittle harness failures or wrong required mappings.
suggested_fix: Scope the pin to the jobs: block only (awk range sed n /^jobs:/,/^[^ ]/ or parse with yq) or maintain an explicit allowlist of job keys.

what: Skipping run_ci_fix_vendor when the per-job loop succeeds omits append-token-record.sh and the FIX_ATTEMPTS TRANSIENT_RETRIES success side effects that only run after a successful run_ci_fix_vendor (scripts/ship-pr.sh:1429-1439 1537-1538).
scenario_or_breakage: Per-job-only fixes may ship without token-record bookkeeping and without bumping FIX_ATTEMPTS or clearing TRANSIENT_RETRIES breaking Trigger B reporting and retry semantics.
suggested_fix: Specify whether to call append-token-record.sh refresh-run-logs and state_set_many from the per-job-only exit path or document intentional omission and adjust any dependents tests.

what: Wiring inserts ci-failed-jobs immediately after gh-run-logs without requiring gh_logs_rc=0.
scenario_or_breakage: Approach says skip the new path when logs are unavailable (rc=3) but wiring can still run gh run view and mis-classify or add noise while CI is in flight.
suggested_fix: Gate the ci-failed-jobs.sh invocation on gh_logs_rc -eq 0 mirroring the vendor skip when rc=3 (scripts/ship-pr.sh:1530-1537).

what: Plan names _RCC_STATUS=head-changed for lint-fix-loop head guard.
scenario_or_breakage: head-changed-after-dispatch surfaces as LINT_FIX_STATUS=failed with FAILURE_REASON not a distinct head-changed status; helper mapping will be wrong unless it keys off FAILURE_REASON.
suggested_fix: Map failed plus FAILURE_REASON=head-changed-after-dispatch to the stall head-changed path or update the plan contract to match emitted KV pairs.

what: ci-failed-jobs exit semantics claim to mirror gh-run-logs plus lib-net classification.
scenario_or_breakage: gh-run-logs.sh does not source lib-net.sh; transient-net-specific exits are not actually mirrored today so implementers may invent new rc behavior vs the cited mirror.
suggested_fix: Align wording with gh-run-logs (grep in-progress rc=3 else rc=1) or explicitly document any new lib-net-based rc=1 subclassification and how ship-pr consumes it.

what: HEAD re-check between helper iterations is described as an existing ship-pr pattern.
scenario_or_breakage: run_checks_with_lint_fix_loop has no git rev-parse between attempts; only lint-fix-loop checks after dispatch.
suggested_fix: Concurrent pushes could slip between command reruns without the claimed guard. Implement an explicit HEAD compare at the start of each helper iteration or drop the existing wording.

what: Per-job rerun uses eval on LOCAL_CMD built from API job names.
scenario_or_breakage: Malicious or unexpected job names could widen injection surface if mapping ever becomes dynamic.
suggested_fix: Document that LOCAL_CMD must come only from the internal case table never interpolated from raw names or add a strict allowlist gate before eval.

what: Integration tests cite generic existing harnesses for lint-fix-loop.
scenario_or_breakage: Implementers may miss updating scripts/test-lint-fix-loop.sh which copies a fixture lint-fix-loop.sh and asserts dispatch behavior (scripts/test-lint-fix-loop.sh:36-51).
suggested_fix: Name scripts/test-lint-fix-loop.sh and required fixture copies flags for --target-cmd validation and ship-pr-ci-per-job prompt text.

scenario_or_breakage: Pattern ^ [a-z][a-z0-9_-]+:$ matches on: keys like workflow_dispatch and pull_request as fake job names causing harness noise or wrong required mappings.
suggested_fix: Limit extraction to the jobs: block only or use an explicit job-name list instead of a whole-file line regex.

what: Per-job-only success skips run_ci_fix_vendor omitting append-token-record and FIX_ATTEMPTS TRANSIENT_RETRIES updates.
scenario_or_breakage: Token-record and counters only run on the successful run_ci_fix_vendor return path; per-job-only fixes may ship without them breaking Trigger B and retry accounting.
suggested_fix: Spell out calling append-token-record.sh refresh-run-logs and state_set_many from the per-job-only path or justify omission and update tests or dependents.

what: Wiring runs ci-failed-jobs immediately after gh-run-logs without gating on gh_logs_rc=0.
scenario_or_breakage: While gh-run-logs returns rc=3 the approach says skip the new path but wiring can still hit gh run view and add wrong classify noise mid-flight.
suggested_fix: Run ci-failed-jobs.sh only when gh_logs_rc -eq 0 aligned with scripts/ship-pr.sh:1530-1537 vendor deferral.

what: _RCC_STATUS=head-changed does not match lint-fix-loop KV contract.
scenario_or_breakage: head-changed-after-dispatch emits LINT_FIX_STATUS=failed and FAILURE_REASON not a distinct head-changed status; helper mapping will miss stall handling unless it reads FAILURE_REASON.
suggested_fix: Map failed plus FAILURE_REASON=head-changed-after-dispatch to the stall path or rename the planned status to match emitted keys.

what: Exit semantics claim mirrors gh-run-logs plus lib-net.
scenario_or_breakage: gh-run-logs.sh never sources lib-net.sh so transient-net mirroring is overstated versus real rc=1 rc=3 behavior.
suggested_fix: Match documented exit codes to gh-run-logs or explicitly add and document any new lib-net-driven behavior and ship-pr handling.

what: HEAD re-check between helper iterations called an existing ship-pr pattern.
scenario_or_breakage: run_checks_with_lint_fix_loop never runs git rev-parse between attempts; only lint-fix-loop checks after dispatch.
suggested_fix: HEAD can move between command reruns without the described guard. Add an explicit rev-parse compare each helper iteration or drop the existing wording.

what: eval on LOCAL_CMD from failed job context.
scenario_or_breakage: If LOCAL_CMD ever incorporated unvalidated strings the shell injection surface grows.
suggested_fix: Require LOCAL_CMD from the fixed case table only document that raw gh job names never reach eval or add a strict token allowlist before eval.

what: Integration tests only mention generic lint-fix-loop harnesses.
scenario_or_breakage: Fixture harness scripts/test-lint-fix-loop.sh copies lint-fix-loop.sh and must be extended for new flags and sites.
suggested_fix: Name scripts/test-lint-fix-loop.sh and list required assertions for --site ship-pr-ci-per-job and --target-cmd validation and prompt body.
